hero.title: Ukeneye igice cy'imodoka? Ufite icyo ugurisha?
hero.lead: Ksmarting Auto ihuza abashaka ibyuma by'imodoka n'ababifite. Ohereza icyifuzo cyangwa utange ibyawe ugurishe, maze uhuzwe.
hero.needText: Ohereza icyifuzo kigaragaza imodoka yawe n'igice ushaka. Abafite icyo gice bazakwandikira.
hero.haveText: Shyiraho ibyo ufite hamwe n'amafoto n'igiciro. Abaguzi babishaka bazakubona.
hero.imgSearchAlt: Urupapuro rwo gushakisha muri porogaramu ya Ksmarting Auto
hero.imgProductAlt: Urupapuro rw'igicuruzwa muri porogaramu ya Ksmarting Auto
hero.imgOptionsAlt: Urupapuro rw'amahitamo muri porogaramu ya Ksmarting Auto

steps.title: Ohereza icyifuzo
steps.text: Vuga igice ukeneye, n'ubwoko, moderi n'umwaka w'imodoka yawe.

steps.title: Wakire ibisubizo
steps.text: Abacuruzi bafite igice  gihuye n'icyo wifuza bakohereza ibyo batanga.

steps.title: Mwumvikane ugifate
steps.text: Muganire, mwemeranye ku giciro, mutegure uko ugifata cyangwa uko kikugezwaho.

steps.title: Shyiraho igicuruzwa
steps.text: Shyiraho amafoto, uko kimeze, igiciro n'aho kiri.

steps.title: Uhuzwe n'abakikeneye
steps.text: Igicuruzwa cyawe kigaragarira abagishakisha cyangwa abakoze icyifuzo kigihuye.

items.title: Ibyifuzo by'ibice
items.text: Saba neza icyo ukeneye, n'iyo nta wari wakigaragaza.

items.title: Ibicuruzwa by'abacuruzi
items.text: Shyiraho ibice byakoreshejwe cyangwa bishya ugere ku baguzi udafite iduka.

items.title: Shakisha ukurikije imodoka
items.text: Yungurura ukurikije ubwoko, moderi n'umwaka ubone ibice bihuye.

items.title: Itumanaho ritaziguye
items.text: Abaguzi n'abacuruzi baravugana bakumvikana ubwabo ku masezerano.

data.title: Amakuru ashyirwa muri sisitemu
data.intro: Kugira ngo ibyifuzo bihuzwe n'ibicuruzwa, porogaramu ikusanya amakuru ari hasi aha. Dore icyo buri ruhande rutanga n'ababasha kukibona.
rows: Igice gishakwa, ubwoko, moderi n'umwaka w'imodoka, ibisobanuro, aho uri, numero ya telefoni
Izina ry'igice, amafoto, uko kimeze, igiciro, aho kiri, numero ya telefoni
Izina, imeri, ijambobanga n'igenamiterere rya konti
data.outro: Ibyifuzo n'ibicuruzwa bihuzwa hakurikijwe izina ry'igice n'amakuru y'imodoka, bityo uko birushaho kuzura, ni ko urushaho kubona igihuye vuba.

contact.title: Twandikire
contact.text: Ufite ikibazo, igitekerezo cyangwa ikibazo ku gicuruzwa? Twohereze imeri.

deleteAccount.title: Siba konti yawe ya Ksmarting Auto
deleteAccount.intro: Ushobora kudusaba gusiba konti yawe n'amakuru yawe bwite igihe cyose. Ohereza icyifuzo cyawe kuri ksmartingauto@gmail.com
requirements: Ohereza icyifuzo ukoresheje imeri ihujwe na konti yawe, cyangwa utubwire numero ya telefoni wiyandikishijeho kugira ngo tumenye ko ari wowe.
Koresha umutwe w'ubutumwa "Siba konti yanjye" kandi ushyiremo amazina yawe yose.
Siba cyangwa urangize ibyifuzo n'ibicuruzwa byawe bikiri ku murongo, cyangwa utubwire tubigusibire.
Rangiza ubucuruzi ubwo ari bwo bwose urimo n'undi mukoresha.
howSteps: Kanda ku mwanya uri hasi, cyangwa wohereze imeri kuri .
Uzuza izina ryawe, numero ya telefoni na imeri ya konti, hanyuma wohereze.
Turagusubiza kugira ngo tubyemeze ko ari wowe, hanyuma dusibe konti.

deleteAccount.noteText: Dusabe guhagarika konti yawe by'agateganyo. Amakuru yawe azaguma aho kugeza ugarutse.

privacy.title: Amabwiriza y'ubuzima bwite
privacy.effective: Itariki itangiriraho gukurikizwa: 30 Nzeri 2026. Aya mabwiriza isobanura amakuru porogaramu ya Ksmarting Auto n'uru rubuga bikusanya, uko tuyakoresha n'amahitamo ufite. Ukoresheje Ksmarting Auto, uba wemeye aya mabwiriza.

sections.title: Abo turi bo
paragraphs: Ksmarting Auto ni porogaramu ihuza abakeneye ibyuma by'imodoka n'ababifite. Ushobora kutwandikira kuri

sections.title: Amakuru dukusanya

items.label: Amakuru ya konti:
items.text: izina ryawe, imeri, numero ya telefoni n'ijambobanga (bibitswe mu buryo burinzwe).

items.label: Ibyifuzo n'ibicuruzwa:
items.text: igice ushaka cyangwa ugurisha, ubwoko, moderi n'umwaka w'imodoka, uko kimeze, igiciro, ibisobanuro, aho ushyiraho, n'amafoto wohereza.

items.label: Ubutumwa:
items.text: ibyo wohereza abandi bakoresha binyuze muri porogaramu.

items.label: Amakuru ya telefoni n'imikoreshereze:
items.text: ubwoko bwa telefoni, verisiyo ya porogaramu n'inyandiko z'amakosa, bikoreshwa kugira ngo porogaramu ikomeze gukora kandi irinzwe.

after: Ntidukusanya amakuru ya karita yo kwishyura muri porogaramu. Abaguzi n'abacuruzi bumvikana ku kwishyura hagati yabo.

items.label: Kamera n'amafoto:
items.text: bigamije kukwemerera gushyiraho amafoto ku gicuruzwa cyangwa ku cyifuzo gusa.

items.label: Ibimenyeshwa:
items.text: bigamije kukumenyesha ibisubizo n'ibihuje gusa. Ushobora kubihagarika mu igenamiterere rya telefoni yawe.
Gushyiraho no gucunga konti yawe.
Guhuza ibyifuzo n'ibicuruzwa no guhuza abaguzi n'abacuruzi.
Kukoherereza ibisubizo, ibihuje n'ubutumwa bw'ingenzi bwa serivisi.
Gukumira uburiganya n'ikoreshwa nabi, no gukemura ibibazo.
Gukurikiza amategeko igihe bibaye ngombwa.
Abandi bakoresha: ibicuruzwa, harimo amafoto, igiciro, aho biri n'amakuru y'itumanaho wahisemo kugaragaza, biboneka ku bakoresha porogaramu. Ibyifuzo biboneka ku bacuruzi basubiza gusa.
Ibigo bitanga serivisi bibika amakuru yacu bikanadufasha gukoresha porogaramu. Bishobora kuyakoresha gusa mu kudutangira serivisi.
Inzego z'ubutegetsi, igihe amategeko abitegetse.

sections.title: Igihe tuyabika
paragraphs: Tubika amakuru yawe igihe konti yawe ikora. Iyo usibye konti, dusiba amakuru yawe nk'uko bisobanurwa hejuru, uretse inyandiko tugomba kubika bitewe n'amategeko.

items.text: Ushobora kureba no guhindura amakuru yawe n'ibicuruzwa byawe muri porogaramu.
Ushobora gusiba icyifuzo cyangwa igicuruzwa icyo ari cyo cyose igihe cyose.
Ushobora gusaba kopi y'amakuru yawe cyangwa kudusaba gusiba konti yawe wandikira .

sections.title: Umutekano
paragraphs: Dukoresha ingamba za tekiniki zikwiye mu kurinda amakuru yawe. Nta sisitemu irinzwe ijana ku ijana, bityo koresha ijambobanga rikomeye kandi ntukarisangize abandi. Huzira n'abandi bakoresha ahantu hizewe kandi usuzume ibice mbere yo kwishyura.

sections.title: Abana
paragraphs: Ksmarting Auto ntigenewe abana bari munsi y'imyaka 18, kandi ntidukusanya amakuru yabo tubizi. Niba utekereza ko umwana yaduhaye amakuru, twandikire tuyasibe.

sections.title: Impinduka kuri aya mabwiriza
paragraphs: Dushobora kuvugurura aya mabwiriza. Tuzahindura itariki iri hejuru kandi, ku mpinduka zikomeye, tubikumenyeshe muri porogaramu.

sections.title: Twandikire
paragraphs: Ufite ibibazo ku buzima bwite? Wandikire kuri
